name: smwgraphics-earthworm-jim-genesis-level
title: Earthworm Jim (Genesis) - Level 5
description:
Once again, I had to reduce the BG size, as that consumed more tiles. Still, palette 3 is easy to edit, most of FG1 is safe and FG3 is free.

Requested by TypeII_Mound

Anorakun's notes: WARNING! This backgrounds uses all of the FG2, BG1, BG2, BG3 slots. Also a small chunk of the FG1 slots. Incompatible with moon, diagonal pipes, horizontal pipes, vines, clouds, bridges, bushes, nets, triangles, cement blocks, outlined blocks, goal signs, and etc. Use at your own risk.

Recommended BG Scroll: None, None.
Preferably with Layer 1 FG Scrolling as No Vertical Scroll.
